Beautifully updated single-story Spanish-style estate on 4.56 private acres in the heart of Temecula Wine Country with spectacular panoramic valley views and verifiable short-term rental income. This exceptional turnkey property is offered fully furnished and move-in ready, featuring 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, an oversized laundry room, a dedicated RV pad with RV parking, no HOA, and low county taxes. A prime secondary homesite offers outstanding potential for an ADU, guest house, trailer, or future expansion.
Ideally located just minutes from Temecula's award-winning wineries, top-rated schools, shopping, dining, and Old Town, this property offers the perfect blend of privacy and convenience.
Designed for comfortable living and entertaining, the open floor plan features soaring cathedral ceilings, beautiful faux wood beams, a custom stone fireplace, and wood-look tile flooring. The impressive kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, expansive counter space, double ovens, a built-in indoor grill, an oversized walk-in pantry, and opens seamlessly to the family room and dining area.
Large picture windows fill the home with natural light while framing picturesque views of the surrounding hills. The spacious primary suite features cathedral ceilings and a spa-inspired bath with a soaking tub, oversized dual walk-in shower, and dual vanities. Relax beneath the covered patio with custom lighting and ceiling fans while enjoying breathtaking sunsets and rolling Wine Country views. Entertain with the built-in BBQ island and sink, gather around the gas fire pit or two gas fire tables, then unwind in the six-person spa. The gently rolling acreage is ideal for a boutique vineyard, orchard, gardens, horses, or the pool of your dreams.
A graded building pad is already equipped with a 100-amp subpanel, water, and septic connections, making it ideal for an ADU, guest house, trailer, or tiny home. Additional amenities include a newer HVAC system, newer water heater, large storage shed, generous attic storage, and an attached 2-car garage. Whether you're seeking a primary residence, Wine Country retreat, or investment opportunity, this exceptional property offers the very best of Temecula Wine Country living.

Nestled on five flat, usable acres in the peaceful hills of De Luz, this private retreat offers the best of both worlds: the serenity of country living with the convenience of being less than 10 minutes from Old Town Temecula, shopping, dining, and major freeways. From the moment you arrive through the electronic gated entrance, you’ll be captivated by the home’s classic wraparound porch, inviting you to slow down, relax, and take in the beauty of the surrounding property. Inside, the farmhouse feel continues with warm, welcoming spaces that have been thoughtfully redesigned with today’s buyer in mind. The open-concept great room is anchored by a dramatic floor-to-ceiling tiled fireplace and features beautiful LVP flooring that flows seamlessly throughout the main living areas. The fully remodeled kitchen combines farmhouse character with sleek, modern finishes, creating the perfect space for entertaining family and friends. Beautifully updated bathrooms, stylish finishes throughout, and even a dedicated dog washing station for practical everyday living all under a newer roof done in 2024. One of the home’s most unique features is the oversized game room with its own private exterior staircase, offering incredible flexibility as a guest suite, multigenerational living space, home office, or potential ADU conversion. Step outside and you’ll discover a backyard designed for making memories. Enjoy sunny afternoons by the sparkling pool, entertain around the outdoor kitchen and BBQ area, or simply relax in the fully fenced grassy yard. Horse lovers will appreciate being steps away from their corral with 3 stalls, while mature citrus trees, expansive usable land, and ample room for a custom workshop, barn, or additional dwelling create endless possibilities. Car enthusiasts and hobbyists will love the two garage setups with space for up to five vehicles, and the included 22kW Generac automatic generator provides peace of mind year-round. A place where wraparound porch mornings, peaceful sunsets, wide-open spaces, and luxurious modern living come together to create the ultimate forever home.

results.remarks:
(VA assumable 2.79% interest rate*) Set in the heart of Sommers Bend, 32163 Verbena Way offers the space, flexibility, and modern comfort today’s buyers are looking for. Built in 2021, this impressive Temecula home features approximately 3,181 square feet with 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and a spacious upstairs loft.

The main living area is open and inviting, with plenty of natural light and a layout that works beautifully for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen anchors the space with a large island, granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, abundant storage, and a walk-in pantry. Just beyond, the oversized living areas provide plenty of room to gather, relax, or host friends and family.

Upstairs, the loft creates an additional flexible living space that can easily function as a home office, game room, media room, or lounge. The primary bedroom is generously sized and includes a private bath with dual sinks, a soaking tub, separate shower, and a large walk-in closet.

The home also includes leased solar, dual-zone air conditioning, an upstairs laundry room with washer and dryer, and a 2-car garage with extra storage. Outside, the backyard offers a private setting with plenty of potential for dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the Temecula weather.

One of the biggest highlights is the Sommers Bend lifestyle. Residents enjoy access to beautifully designed community amenities including a resort-style pool and spa, fitness center, clubhouse, sports courts, playgrounds, BBQ and picnic areas, fire pits, and an extensive network of walking and jogging trails.

Located just minutes from Temecula Wine Country, Old Town Temecula, shopping, restaurants, schools, and the I-15, this home combines a highly desirable location with the benefits of one of Temecula’s premier master-planned communities. High-speed fiber internet is also available.

Turnkey 5-bedroom, 3-bath home with a 3-car garage (with EV Charger) situated on a private cul-de-sac lot with NO rear neighbors, rolling mountain views a LOW $40/month HOA, and a LOW tax rate. This home is unique as it features an expansive 12K plus square foot privacy-focused lot that wraps around this home like a hug and provides ample select spaces like a dog run, room for a home garden, sun corner or fire pit area, 2 Aluma wood patio covers all planned to maximize the use of its complete footprint. Several landscaping textures like plush green grass, olive trees, palm trees, ever green shrubbery, upgraded river rock in all of the surrounding planters in the backyard and malibu lighting to create that soft glow as a you take in night swim or dinner at dusk on your covered patio with electric operating roll down shades and 3 oscillating fans with lights. All of these features work to create a serene outdoor space. 
Inside the home the popular floor plan features a main-floor bedroom and full bath with a walk-in shower, with French doors opening directly to the south-facing pool, providing all-day sunshine. 

The open-concept kitchen features white cabinetry, soft-close drawers, a custom glass backsplash, stainless steel appliances, a butler’s pantry, and a large island overlooking the family room. LED recessed lighting and updated ceiling fans have been installed throughout the home. 

The spacious primary suite spans the back of the home and offers beautiful sunrise views, plantation shutters, a sitting area, an upgraded large soaking tub and separate walk-in shower, and dual closets. 

In addition to the primary suite, 3 additional rooms and a large loft are located upstairs. One of those rooms is used currently as a workout room and is equipped with a mini-split air conditioner so that you can stay nice and cool while you push your workout to the max. There's more.  The attached three car garage comes nicely appointed with beige epoxy floors, built in work bench, and white cabinets w/ ample storage.  So, whether you are considering this home for its multigenerational functionalities, nearby schools like Great Oak High School, close proximity to parks and recreation, Temecula Valley Hospital and shopping, the nightlife of Pechanga, or the excellent eateries and excitement of Old Town Temecula; you will find that this home offers all of that and more. 
Solar Power Purchase Agreement to convey at approx. $230 a month.

This prestigious home features an open floor plan and vaulted ceiling entry, including a dual access stairway consisting of 3747 s.f. The home features 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms and an open loft with a front balcony area flanked by 2 spacious secondary bedrooms and a full bath. The kitchen becomes the heart of the home and is open to the formal dining/living room and family room on each side for easy entertaining. The crisp white kitchen cabinets and stylish glass mullion cupboards are centered by a large kitchen island and accented by dark granite counter tops and backsplash for a stunning finish.  The large primary suite features a separate retreat area for home office, media, fitness or nursery. Enjoy beautiful views of the golf course, sunsets and mountains from the privacy of your own spacious balcony. You will love the open bathroom suite with a large custom closet space fit for the stars, dual vanity sinks, large soaking tub and walk in shower. Downstairs bedroom and full bath allow for the convenience of multi generational living and guests. FORMER MODEL HOME | DESIGNER INTERIORS | BREATHTAKING HILL & MOUNTAIN VIEWS | IMPECCABLY MAINTAINED
A rare opportunity to own a beautifully preserved former model home in Morgan Hill. This approximately 3,145-square-foot residence offers 5 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, thoughtfully designed with exceptional attention to detail and quality rarely found in a resale home.
The sophisticated interiors feature wide-plank solid hardwood flooring, upgraded carpeting in soft, elegant tones, and designer-selected solid wood furnishings, artwork, and décor—all remarkably well preserved. Every element was thoughtfully curated to create a cohesive, timeless, and inviting living environment.
The spectacular view balcony is truly special, offering expansive views of rolling hills and distant mountains, unforgettable sunsets, and seasonal snow-capped mountain scenery. Enjoy watching hot-air balloons drift across the valley, the annual Independence Day fireworks, and beautiful celestial events from the comfort of home.
The location adds to the appeal, with Madigan Park approximately a five-minute walk away and Galleron Park about ten minutes away. Residents enjoy one of Temecula's premier resort-style clubhouses and an excellent collection of community amenities with a reasonable HOA.
Additional upgrades include a whole-house water softener and purchased solar panels.
A personal highlight is the lovingly cultivated rose garden, featuring more than 80 rare rose varieties developed over approximately ten years. Each spring, particularly from April through June, the garden becomes one of the community's most spectacular floral displays.
Beautifully designed. Exceptionally preserved. Truly turnkey. More than a former model home, this is a truly cherished home—lovingly cared for and thoughtfully preserved over the years.
Morgan Hill community makes a destination, with the prestigious Redhawk golf club and renowned wineries. The Clubhouse amenities offer heated swimming pool (including Lap pool), Tennis /Pickleball courts, Craft room, fitness, game room and activities like movie night and even more! Low HOA ,Low tax! All the furnishing could be included in the price or sold it separately.

results.remarks: PRICE REDUCTION. This property is located on almost 10 acres in the desirable De Luz community with a 3955 sq.ft. main house plus a 931 sq.ft. detached guest house. Both homes have amazing views and breathtaking sunsets including views of the local Cross Creek golf course. Other features include a swimming pool and spa, an organic avocado and citrus grove, family orchard, a huge RV garage and a great location with an easy drive to town. The custom built main home has 12ft. high ceilings in the entry with 10ft. ceilings throughout. Features throughout the main house includes wood flooring, custom quality crown molding,built in cabinets and was specifically designed to enjoy the views from almost every room providing lots of natural light throughout. The well designed kitchen includes a large island, granite countertops, newer appliances including double ovens and a sub zero refrigerator plus lots of cabinetry and storage and a walk in pantry. The comfortable family room features a custom built fireplace encased by built in cabinets on either side. The huge private master suite overlooks  and opens to the landscaped fenced backyard and pool and spa area. There is a lovely separate formal living room and dining room plus an office with built in cabinets and book shelves. The 4th bedroom with an en suite bathroom is upstairs. Other features include a new water filtration system, newer AC units plus central vac system. The guest house was built in 2006. It features a living room, totally self contained kitchen, one bedroom plus a bonus room that could be used as a second bedroom plus a full bathroom. It also has an outdoor enclosed living area with surrounding glass windows where you can enjoy amazing views and breathtaking sunsets.It has its own laundry facilities located downstairs in the 40x30 ft. RV garage that also has a workshop area and attic storage. The certified organic grove includes a variety of trees including avocados, Kara Kara oranges, pink lemons, and tangerines with almost 5 acres of land to plant a vineyard or add to the grove. Also enjoy a family orchard and vegetable garden including lemons, berries, apples, nectarines, pears, red and sweet onions and tomatoes. The property is completely fenced with a custom gate. A leased solar system for both homes. The main home has a 3 car garage plus there is lots of parking space. This property offers a great lifestyle and location close to the city of Temecula Old town and Wine Country to also enjoy.

results.remarks: Experience the romance of the Italian countryside in the heart of De Luz. Set behind a private gate on approximately 5 acres, this extraordinary 4,231 sq ft estate captures breathtaking panoramic valley views, unforgettable sunsets, and the ultimate sense of privacy—just 10 minutes from town. A grand double door entry welcomes you into a warm and inviting interior highlighted by travertine floors, wood floors, rich knotty alder cabinetry and interior doors. The main living level is perfectly designed for everyday living and entertaining, featuring a spacious dining room, comfortable family room with wood floors, a stunning wood-burning stone fireplace, and walls of windows that frame the incredible views. The chef’s kitchen opens seamlessly to the family room and is beautifully appointed with a 5-burner cooktop, new Wolf double ovens, built-in refrigerator, dishwasher, trash compactor, pantry, island, and bar seating—all positioned to take in the picturesque scenery. The main-floor primary suite is a private retreat with its own fireplace, deck access, and sweeping views. The spa-inspired bathroom offers travertine finishes, a soaking tub, walk-in shower, bidet, dual vanities, and a spacious walk-in closet with built ins. An enclosed breezeway creates an exceptional indoor-outdoor entertaining space, complete with a built-in barbecue, beer tap, beverage and wine refrigerators, expansive serving counters, iron doors at both ends for a refreshing cross breeze, and even a wood-fired pizza oven—perfect for unforgettable gatherings. The lower level features four additional bedrooms (including one currently used as a game room with a walk-in closet), two full bathrooms, and direct access to a covered patio that leads to the resort-style backyard. Step outside to your own private oasis showcasing a spectacular pool w/ waterfalls, spa, dramatic water features, and an outdoor kitchen—all set against the backdrop of endless views. The property also includes raised garden beds and a charming chicken coop for a true farm-to-table lifestyle. This is more than a home—it’s a destination. A rare opportunity to own one of De Luz’s most picturesque and captivating view properties.

results.remarks: Temecula Wine Country Estate,  LOW Taxes, NO HOA.  Tuscan Farm Style, single story with amazing panoramic views over Valle de los Caballos and across the city of Temecula all the way to Pechanga Resort and Casino.  Views of Palomar Mountain and Observatory.  This home provides for quiet yet convenient Wine Country living! Floor plan is amazing and lends itself to comfortable entertaining from small to large groups.  Relax on the wrap around loggia style patio or in the stunning custom-built Wine room. Located between the Deportola Wine Trail, and Rancho California Rd wineries making trips to your favorite winery simple and easy.  The home is on paved road and close to retail and restaurants.  The property has a private gated entry that leads up a tree lined driveway to the very large parking pad in front of the home.  There is ample space to add a vineyard, orchard, small equestrian area, pool etc.  Front of home is landscaped and accented by double solid wood doors entering a very large foyer with high ceilings and cupola for added light.  5 bedrooms located on the east wing of the home, formal Living and dining room along the back boasting panoramic views and double-sided fireplace. Across from them is a one-of-a-kind Custom built wine room, with stone walled interior, lighted and refrigerated walk-in wine storage for approximately 1200 bottles, and a wet bar.  Open concept fireplaced family room, eat-in area, gourmet kitchen, oversized pantry, laundry, and 6th Bedroom/casita make up the west wing of the home. Chef's Kitchen has Wolf/Subzero/Cove appliances, Miele Coffee Machine, oversized island and custom cabinets.  Casita could be used as a 6th Bedroom, office, craft room, or media room, and has its own door to the front walkway. Oversized three car garage, fenced dog run.  Huge Wrap around patio accents the side and back yards leading to the amazing panoramic views.  Home has HALO water softener, whole house back-up 26KW GENERAC generator, 50 solar panels to be paid off at close with accepted offer. Welcome to an exceptional home in the highly sought-after Lake Harveston community, where tree-lined streets, resort-style amenities, and a picturesque lakeside setting create an inviting neighborhood atmosphere.

This beautifully maintained residence offers 4 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and a spacious loft/bonus room featuring a custom built-in mahogany Murphy bed and bookcases. This versatile space is ideal for a home office, media room, playroom, guest retreat, or potential 5th bedroom.

Step through the grand entry and experience an immediate sense of space, with dramatic 22-foot ceilings, abundant natural light, wide hallways, and an elegant open staircase. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers generous living spaces with a comfortable flow for both everyday living and entertaining.

The gourmet kitchen combines style and functionality with granite countertops, rollout cabinetry, a decorative backsplash, and premium GE Profile appliances.

Designed for Southern California indoor-outdoor living, the backyard is an entertainer's dream. Enjoy a built-in Jenn-Air BBQ and griddle, sink, under-counter refrigerator, bar seating, and multiple covered patio areas. Mature lemon, apple, pear, and guava trees are complemented by colorful roses and flowering vines, creating a private and inviting outdoor retreat.

The spacious primary suite features a professionally designed his-and-hers walk-in closet system, providing exceptional organization and storage.

Numerous upgrades enhance comfort, efficiency, and convenience, including a 27-panel solar system with backup battery, whole-house water purification system, UV and heat-reducing window coatings, Google Nest video doorbell, and monitored security system.

Best of all, the home is located just one block from the lake and close to Harveston's impressive community amenities, including the clubhouse, pool, spa, splash pad, playgrounds, parks, and pedal boats. The scenic 0.8-mile paved trail surrounding the lake provides a beautiful setting for walking, jogging, and biking.

Immaculately maintained and rarely available, this exceptional home combines generous living space, thoughtful upgrades, outstanding outdoor entertaining, and the distinctive Lake Harveston lifestyle.

results.remarks: CRAFTMANSHIP THAT MUST BE SEEN!  LOCATED IN DE LUZ ~ TEMECULA! CUSTOM 22-HORSE STALL ESTATE HOME where timeless elegance and unmatched privacy come together is sure to be the one for you! Located on 4.52 acres surrounded by more than 150 majestic oak trees, and a year-round creek. Featuring luxurious indoor-outdoor living in a breathtaking natural setting just minutes from Old Town Temecula, renowned wineries, shopping, and within the award-winning Murrieta School District. From the moment you arrive, the impressive driveway with pull-through porte-cochère winds through beautifully landscaped grounds, creating an unforgettable first impression. The stunning imported brick and stone exterior exudes timeless sophistication, while the serene setting provides complete tranquility and privacy. Inside, the spacious open floor plan is filled with natural light and enhanced by multiple sets of French doors leading outside, elegant hand-scraped oak flooring, crown molding, custom built-ins, surround sound, and a sunken wet bar. The expansive great room is designed for effortless entertaining and comfortable everyday living. The gourmet kitchen is truly spectacular, featuring custom oak cabinetry and bookshelves, stainless steel appliances, a hooded 6-burner stove, double ovens, two dishwashers, and an extraordinary 12-foot granite island offering abundant prep and gathering space. The luxurious main level primary suite is a private sanctuary complete with its own fireplace, spacious sitting area, dual walk-in closet with custom organization systems, and a spa-inspired bath featuring Carrara marble counters, a double walk-in steam shower, his and hers toilets, and a relaxing soaking tub. A spacious office, secondary bedroom, and 3/4 bath can also be found on the main floor. Upstairs, a private guest retreat offers two ensuite bedrooms with full baths, a large living room, and kitchenette; providing ideal accommodations for guests or multigenerational living. Designed to embrace California living at its finest, the expansive covered porch spans the length of the home and opens to a scenic wooded backdrop, complete with an outdoor entertaining area featuring an authentic Argentine grill, imported Italian wood-fired pizza oven, sink, and granite counters. The property also offers incredible versatility with room to add a pool, vineyard, or additional equestrian facilities.

results.remarks: 4,046 sqft Morgan Hill Home! Don't Miss This One! Walking distance to Morgan Hill Clubhouse Pool & Amenities, Top South Temecula Schools, and Neighborhood Trails. This 5-bed, 4-bath, 3-car garage home has all the space you need and then some. An elegant formal living and formal dining room welcomes you. Luxury vinyl plank wood floors, window shutters, and modern light fixtures are found throughout the home. The kitchen is grand w/the entire family room and daily dining area combining to create an open-concept space. Featuring lots of cabinets for storage, an island w/breakfast bar, high-end stainless-steel appliances and range hood, granite counters w/backsplash, a walk-in pantry + pass-through butler’s pantry, and a kitchen desk area at the heart of it all. The backyard is peaceful, private, and spacious. You’ll love the trees, bushes, mature palms, and nicely landscaped slope which provides natural privacy. The stamped concrete design and covered patio w/ceiling fans are ready for your backyard enjoyment. Keep the playset or easily reclaim that space w/more grass, a conversational firepit area, or even a cocktail pool/spool fits well here (HOA already provides nice pools). The side yard is large enough for RV parking or other useful purposes. Completing the downstairs is 1 bedroom, 1 full bathroom, and an inside laundry room w/sink and cabinets. Upstairs is a Gigantic & Versatile Bonus Loft that you will love! Use it as a family room, homeschool zone, game room, theatre, gym, an additional bedroom suite, or expand the primary bedroom (you do you). The current Primary Bedroom Suite is already large and features a huge walk-in closet, an extra coat closet, an ensuite bathroom w/shower and soaker tub, lots of counter and cabinet space, his and her sink vanities, and a makeup station. Three other upstairs bedrooms are generous in size, with two of them sharing Direct Access to a Jack and Jill Bathroom - families love this feature! Surrounded by scenic foothills, residents of Morgan Hill enjoy a private community center with swimming pools, spa, tennis courts, fitness center, game room, two ballrooms and outdoor fireplace lounge. Plus access to highly acclaimed schools and parks, excellent shopping and entertainment, and notable golfing. And of course, just minutes from renowned local wineries, fine dining, Old Town Temecula, and Pechanga Resort & Casino. Don't let this home pass you by!

results.remarks:
Welcome to this newly built custom estate nestled near the rolling vineyards of Temecula Wine Country — where modern luxury, privacy, and timeless design come together across two breathtaking acres. Tucked behind a private gated entrance with an expansive DG driveway leading to an oversized 3-car garage, this exceptional property offers unmatched privacy, a striking modern exterior, and your very own producing vineyard — ideal for creating a private wine label or selling locally.

As you enter the home, you are welcomed by soaring 10-foot ceilings, a fabulous dining area, and an expansive oversized great room designed with an open-concept layout that seamlessly blends comfort and elegance. Center stage in the great room is a massive statement fireplace, creating a stunning focal point and the perfect gathering space for relaxing or entertaining. Natural light pours throughout the home, enhancing the warm yet sophisticated atmosphere.

The stunning bright white chef’s kitchen is truly the heart of the home, featuring custom cabinetry, premium finishes, an oversized center island, and a spacious walk-in pantry designed for effortless entertaining and everyday functionality.

The luxurious primary suite is a true private retreat, complete with direct access to the covered California Room patio and serene vineyard views. The spa-inspired primary bath features an oversized walk-in shower, soaking tub, and expansive walk-in closet, creating the perfect sanctuary to relax and unwind.

Thoughtfully designed for both comfort and privacy, the home also includes a separate front bedroom with its own private bathroom — ideal for guests, a home office, or multigenerational living. Additional bedrooms are situated down the hall from the primary suite and feature their own bonus gathering area, offering flexible living space for family, work, or play. Abundant storage throughout the home adds convenience and functionality to the elegant design.

Beyond the residence, the property continues to impress with multiple sheds, including two equipped with air conditioning, providing ideal spaces for hobbies, workshops, creative studios, or additional storage.

This extraordinary Wine Country estate offers the rare opportunity to enjoy modern luxury living surrounded by your own private vineyard oasis.

All main living areas are conveniently located on one level, creating comfort and ease throughout the home. The primary suite is privately positioned on its own wing, offering a peaceful retreat. On the opposite side of the home, three additional bedrooms provide an ideal layout — two connected by a Jack-and-Jill bathroom, while the front bedroom enjoys its own private bath.
The spacious kitchen features rich wood cabinetry, granite countertops, and ample prep space, opening to inviting living areas with beautiful natural light and serene views.
A lower-level multipurpose room with private entrance and half  bathroom offers incredible flexibility — perfect for guests, extended family, a home office, gym, or media space.
The property includes an electric gate, paved driveway, and a graded pad ready for a future ADU. covered Alum wood back patio ideal for outdoor entertaining, wiring for surround sound and security cameras, and built-in speakers installed in the downstairs living areas, gutters and a sprinkler system installed along the property slopes for added functionality and ease of maintenance, with room for a pool, vineyard, or outdoor entertaining area, the possibilities are endless. Enjoy privacy, open space, and panoramic views just minutes from Temecula’s renowned wineries, dining, and shopping.

results.remarks:
A Rare 10 Acre Temecula Wine Country Estate with Vineyard, Olive Grove and Winery Potential

Welcome to one of Temecula Wine Country’s most captivating luxury estates, an ultra private 10 acre Mediterranean Tuscan retreat with panoramic vineyard and equestrian views and rare income producing potential.

A grand double door entry opens to soaring cathedral ceilings and a light filled interior where every window frames breathtaking scenery. The home blends timeless architecture with elevated finishes, offering formal dining, a custom executive office with built ins, and a butler’s prep area that flows seamlessly into a walk in wine cellar, perfect for entertaining at scale.

The kitchen is a true showpiece, designed for both the culinary enthusiast and the entertainer. Rich, custom crafted cabinetry with intricate detailing is paired with expansive granite surfaces, a built in Viking refrigerator, and a dedicated coffee station. The oversized layout offers generous prep space and effortless flow, while the sunlit eat in dining area overlooks the grounds, creating a warm, inviting space that is both functional and striking.

Lives like a single level with a main floor primary suite overlooking the resort style pool, while three oversized upstairs bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, office, or gym. The outdoor experience rivals a private resort, complete with a custom BBQ island featuring a Traeger, kegerator, and refrigerator, a bocce ball court, stone walkways through a charming orchard, and curated lighting throughout.

Approximately 7 acres of producing vines including Viognier, Zinfandel, and Cabernet and 1.5 acres of olive trees enhance both lifestyle and value. Grandfathered C/V zoning allows potential for a Class I winery tasting room, B and B, or Country Inn. Additional highlights include PAID OFF NEM 2.0 solar, full smart home integration including Alexa, Nest, Lutron, and Ring, and RV pad with 50 amp hookup, all just minutes from Temecula’s top wineries and dining, Blue Ribbon Schools and vibrant night life of Pechanga Resort and Old Town Temecula. FULL DETAILS @ https://calilookbook.aryeo.com/sites/emoywopk/unbranded

results.remarks:
Car lovers, hobbyists and collectors, this one is for you with approximately 1,300 sq ft of garage space on two levels! This unique offering also includes two separate parcels totaling 12.78 acres: the first is approximately 6.53 acres with the custom home and avocado grove, while the second is approximately 6.25 acres featuring an avocado grove, a seasonal stream, majestic oaks and sycamores, and utilities extending to the end of a cul-de-sac road. Enter through a gated entry onto a paver driveway and enjoy the natural boulder landscaping and a variety of fruit trees, including oranges, lemons, kumquats and tangerines, which add to the property’s distinctive curb appeal. Discover the beauty and tranquility of De Luz in this exceptional property offering privacy, panoramic views, usable acreage, and endless possibilities—all just minutes from Temecula and Interstate 15. With its expansive acreage and natural beauty, the property offers an incredible opportunity for an estate, agricultural use, or potential horse properties.
The quality custom home features breathtaking panoramic views across the gentle west hills of De Luz, with a beautiful balcony overlooking your private avocado paradise. Enter at the main level of approximately 2783 sq ft with 4 bedrooms, 3 baths, great room and kitchen plus formal dining room.  Custom wood cabinetry enhances the kitchen, dining room, and family room. Kitchen features are complemented by a wet bar, pull out cabinet drawers, a pass through to the formal dining room and a spacious walk-in pantry.  Thoughtful details include custom wood front doors, 8 ft solid core raised panel interior doors, formal dining room bay window, ceiling fans, and recessed lighting. Solar tubes add natural light to the master closet and downstairs hallway. The lower level adds approx. 872 square feet of flexible space, ideal for a hobby room, home theater, bonus room, studio, or additional living space, creating exceptional potential for guest accommodations, multigenerational living, or a private workspace.  There is another large deck on the lower level with incredible views. This level also features a full bathroom and has an attached, approx. 585 sq ft two-car tandem garage, in addition to the upper approx. 730 sq ft garage. Enjoy the peaceful De Luz lifestyle while remaining minutes from Temecula’s shopping, restaurants, and theaters. A truly special property offering space, versatility, and incredible potential.

results.remarks: VIEWS, VIEWS, VIEWS! Arguably the Finest Panoramic Views in All of De Luz! Perched high above the Temecula Valley at the end of a cul-de-sac, this extraordinary gated single-story estate offers an unrivaled front-row seat to nature’s masterpiece. It's set on approximately 5.67 acres, with beautifully landscaped grounds, framed by more than 150 ft of towering Italian Cypress trees. The property captures breathtaking 180-degree views of rolling mountains, tranquil valleys, spectacular sunsets, and sparkling city lights of Temecula below. Offering 3,844 Sq ft, this custom estate features 4 Bedrooms, 3.5 Bathrooms, two separate 2-car Garages, and a stunning saltwater infinity-edge pool with the ambiance of a luxury resort. An elegant foyer welcomes you with soaring vaulted ceilings, cascading chandeliers, rich travertine flooring, crown molding, and custom coved architectural details. Expansive picture windows throughout the home frame the spectacular views, making the surrounding landscape a living work of art from nearly every room. Designed for both grand entertaining and comfortable everyday living, the home offers formal living and dining rooms, an executive office, an inviting family room, an informal dining area, and a gourmet chef’s kitchen. Rich triple-milled cabinetry with soft-close drawers, granite countertops, a large center island, pull-out shelving, a six-burner Viking cooktop, double ovens, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious walk-in pantry make this kitchen as functional as it is beautiful. The luxurious primary suite is a peaceful retreat featuring a fireplace, private patio access, dual walk-in closets, dual vanities, a dedicated makeup station, walk-in shower, private water closet, and an elegant soaking tub positioned beneath a chandelier. Three additional bedrooms, including one ensuite, provide comfort and privacy for family & guests. Step outside and experience what truly makes this estate unforgettable, The infinity-edge pool that becomes one with the endless horizon. In the early mornings, a gentle layer of valley mist often settles below, creating the remarkable sensation of floating above the clouds. By evening, the twinkling lights of Temecula transform the landscape into an unforgettable panorama. This is more than a luxury home—it’s one of De Luz’s most extraordinary view properties. Just minutes from Old Town Temecula, award-winning wineries, shopping, dining, and easy freeway access it's truly a rare opportunity.

results.remarks:
Get ready to be captivated by this beautiful custom-built contemporary farmhouse new construction, now offered at a significant savings from its previously advertised price. With construction well underway and the home nearing completion, this is a unique opportunity for a new owner to step in, complete the remaining details, and add their own personal touches—including landscaping and outdoor living spaces—to make this remarkable property truly their own.
Offering more than 3,700 square feet on two levels, this home is nestled in the beautiful hills of Temecula, better known as DeLuz. Designed for the distinguished buyer, it offers 5 spacious bedrooms, including two primary suites, and 4 full baths.
The heart of the home features a spacious great room with an elegant fireplace, rich hardwood flooring, and expansive bi-fold patio doors that showcase the surrounding views and create a wonderful connection between indoor and outdoor living. The gourmet kitchen features a large center island with ample storage, custom floor-to-ceiling cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, elegant hardware, and dedicated wine storage.
Upstairs, the second primary suite creates a private retreat along with a generous flex room ideal for a nursery, office, media room, or additional living space. Step outside onto the expansive balcony and enjoy sweeping views across the valley and surrounding hills.
The baths are designed with custom cabinetry, walk-in tiled showers, and soaking tubs. Energy-efficient design, abundant natural light, generous storage, interior laundry, and a deep two-car garage add to the home’s comfort and functionality.
Outside, the property provides a blank canvas for the new owner to create the landscaping, outdoor entertaining areas, and future pool of their choosing—all designed around the property’s beautiful setting and incredible views. It is a rare opportunity to complete a custom new-construction home with your own vision rather than inherit someone else’s choices.
Enjoy privacy and tranquility in the heart of Temecula while remaining approximately 6 minutes from Old Town Temecula and 15 minutes from Temecula Wine Country, with highly regarded schools and convenient freeway access.
If you are looking for custom new construction, privacy, beautiful views, and the opportunity to put your own finishing touches on a home at a significant savings from its previously advertised price, you have found HOME!

results.remarks: Enter through the reclaimed 100-year-old Ohio barn wood gate with custom stonework into a private, nearly 10-acre modern farmhouse estate in the heart of Temecula’s wine country. White board-and-batten Hardie siding, limestone accents, black metal roof, and solar panels overlook mature vineyards and mountains. A circular drive, olive trees, and a  multi-car garage welcome you home. Inside, polished concrete floors and soaring white shiplap vaulted ceilings create an airy open-concept living space. The open floor plans allows you to gather around a wood-burning fireplace with custom built-ins, also allowing for a spacious entertaining area for dining. Floor-to-ceiling black-framed sliding doors erase boundaries, revealing the glowing pool, patio, and endless vineyard views. The chef’s kitchen dazzles with custom European white oak cabinets, a dramatic quartzite waterfall island with farmhouse sink and seating, professional Wolf range, Sub-Zero fridge, Miele coffee system, wine fridge, open shelving, and Clé Tile. A walk-in butler’s pantry with full sink, brass fixtures, and additional prep space makes entertaining effortless. A bright laundry room with dual machines, long counters, and vineyard views, plus a stylish powder room, complete the practical luxury. The primary suite offers a soaking tub, Clé Belgian-tile shower, and generous custom closet. The additional spacious bedrooms all have commanding views. Outside, the custom micro-pebble saltwater pool with European tile, stone fire pit, and reclaimed-wood BBQ kitchen invite twilight gatherings. Working gardens, a chicken coop, full irrigation, and a one-acre Cabernet Sauvignon vineyard deliver authentic farm-to-table living. With a 26 kW backup generator, a rolling 9+ acres with a future build site for a shop, ADU or a guest house, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath sanctuary blends modern design, warm details, and pure Temecula wine-country serenity.

results.remarks: Welcome to this beautiful single story Meadowview home with a FOUR Car Garage, a POOL, a full GUEST HOUSe, amazing architecture, and fully turnkey. The primary suite is massive with tons of additional space for dressers or even its own lounge area. The family room has a custom built in as well as a beautiful fireplace with a floor to ceiling backsplash and beautiful light fixtures beneath. Moving past the kitchen you will find two more spacious guest bedrooms sharing a jack & jill guest bath. Moving to the guest house, you will find  a full kitchen, private living room , bedroom and full bathroom with a walk in shower. This home is perfect for anyone looking for multi-generation living!! Making your way to the backyard you will be amazed with all of the outdoor living space with a fully built patio spanning the perimeter of about half the home. It truly feels like a resort with all the nature & trees offering privacy, a fully operating koi pond with beautiful koi swimming , and of course your private pool with a fully functioning rock waterfall feature. This home has it all, schedule your tour to view it now !

results.remarks: **Attention Winemaker Dreamers!** We are thrilled to present an extraordinary and rare opportunity: 11.4 acres of prime land located at the entrance of Temecula Wine Country—your first and last stop for visitors, right next to the NEW Temecula Wine Country sign and Halter Ranch Winery! Imagine living in a stunning Spanish-style home with 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, a loft, and 3,532 sq. ft. of living space—perfect for you to reside in while crafting your dream winery or to serve as a potential guest cottage. Additional highlights include a retail fruit stand of 356 sq ft, an outdoor patio serving area, and a planned 2,400 sq. ft. production warehouse, with grading set to begin in early 2026. With a parking lot currently accommodating approximately 30 cars, plans are in place to expand to 60, ensuring ample space for your visitors. Don’t miss this rare offering—ideal for winemakers, investors, or anyone dreaming of a premier vineyard estate. Stay tuned, as this gem will go live after the first of the year. **2026 is YOUR year to own this winery dream!** Photos and video of the single-family home interior and the upcoming production / storage warehouse have been virtually staged to showcase the properties' potential.

This custom single-story retreat blends comfort, character, and versatility in all the right ways. results.remarks: Home is where every holiday memory begins. You will discover how special this home feels the minute  you step through the front door into a foyer that immediately wraps you in warmth. The formal living and dining rooms are made for hosting,  think holiday toasts, a beautifully set table, and all the people you love under one roof. The family room is the true heart of the home. Gather around the fireplace and string popcorn & berries.  The large office with warm wood paneling offers a cozy place to enjoy working during the season.  Imagine the aroma of a holiday feast coming together as you look out over your own private winter wonderland in the spacous kitchen. The grand staircase leads to 4 generously sized bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. The primary suite is a true retreat, complete with a private deck to enjoy a cup of cocoa under the stars. The primary bathroom with double vanities, a walk-in shower, and a separate soaking tub is the  ideal  space for unwinding after a busy day of holiday hosting. Two large secondary bedrooms with a Jack & Jill bathroom  make the perfect place for the rest of the family. The additional bedroom & bathroom offer another room for addiional family or guests. The  brand new A/C unit, assures comfort is covered no matter the season. The outdoor space is also ready to spread holiday cheer. Set on nearly 1/2 an acre, it offers generous space for gardening, recreation, and outdoor cooking. The multiple seating areas are perfect to gather under the stars and sip cocoa.  There's plenty of room for horses,  plus a large three-car garage, storage shed, and gated parking for your RV, boat, toy hauler, classic car, or that new adult toy you wished for. The Meadowview community sits on 360 beautifully maintained acres, with 23 miles of hiking and riding trails for crisp winter walks. When it's time to celebrate together, residents enjoy exclusive access to pickleball courts, basketball & tennis courts, 2 pools + a kiddie pool, a  clubhouse,  and  an equestrian arena,  amenities that make this community feel like home all year long. Temecula is a place to call home any time of the year. The beautiful wineries, top rated schools, convenient shopping, and diverse dining are  just minutes away. Perfect for celebratating and discovering new holiday traditions together.  This is more than a house, it’s a place to create memories that last a lifetime. Come see why this could be the home you come back to, every holiday, for years to come.

The attached casita offers a private entrance and its own full bathroom, functioning as a guest suite, home office, gym, or multigenerational living space. This home sits within walking distance of the Meadowview pool and close to the horse arena — one of the most convenient locations in the community while still feeling tucked away.

Located minutes from Old Town Temecula, Temecula Valley Wine Country, Promenade Temecula, dining, and the I-15 corridor. Temecula Valley Unified School District.

A rare opportunity awaits in The Masters, an exclusive enclave within the highly desirable Temeku Hills golf
community. Privately positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac with The Legends Golf Club fairway beyond the
backyard, this newly renovated and meticulously refreshed 5-bedroom, 4-bath home offers approximately 3,557
square feet on an expansive 16,117-square-foot lot. Soaring ceilings, crown molding, abundant natural light, and
generous room sizes create an impressive sense of space, while two fireplaces with custom hearths and mantels
bring warmth to the formal living and family rooms. Thoughtfully designed by an executive chef, the gourmet
kitchen pairs professional performance with striking style. Highlights include a premium 48-inch THOR Kitchen
six-burner gas rangetop with built-in griddle, pot filler, oversized stainless-steel hood, double wall ovens, rich navy
cabinetry, custom designer backsplash, granite countertops, and a walk-in pantry. A grand granite island anchors
the space with a high-arc Moen faucet, oversized undermount sink, built-in wine refrigerator, illuminated interior
cabinetry, soft-closing cabinets and drawers, abundant storage, and exceptional room for gathering. The flexible
floor plan includes a versatile main-floor room with double-door entry and an adjacent full bath, ideal as an office,
study, optional bedroom, or flex space. Upstairs, a spacious junior suite offers a private bath and customized closet
storage. The serene primary suite overlooks the backyard and features a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, jetted
soaking tub, separate glass-enclosed shower, and two walk-in closets. The private backyard is a breathtaking
tropical oasis centered around a lagoon-style PebbleTec pool with cascading waterfalls, cave-like grotto, shallow
walk-in entry, and rock waterslide built into the lushly landscaped hillside. An elevated spa, firepit, covered patio,
and palapa-covered outdoor kitchen featuring BULL stainless-steel appliances, along with mature palms, natural
boulders, and multiple gathering areas, create an unforgettable setting for year-round Southern California living.
Additional highlights include a three-car garage, gated side-yard space, refreshed exterior trim, and revitalized
landscaping with lush plantings and sculptural agave. Near Temecula Wine Country, golf, shopping, dining,
schools, and freeway access, this extraordinary home is ready to impress.

results.remarks: Beautiful Views, Elite Craftsmanship, and Custom Luxury in Meadowview! Finish your dream estate in Temecula’s sought-after Meadowview. On a half-acre lot, this 2-story custom home spans 2,942 sq ft with 4 beds, a dedicated office, 3.5 baths, and a 3-car garage. Designed for functional living and scenic views, the layout features a mudroom, great room fireplace, and outdoor patio fireplace. Active building permits and architectural plans are fully transferable and included. Built by highly reviewed subcontractors under strict owner-builder oversight, ensuring excellent workmanship. Extensive site prep is complete, including grading, foundation, septic, and premium engineered block retaining walls. Framing, full wall/attic insulation, and textured drywall are finished, and high-end exterior and garage doors are installed. No expense was spared on the exterior, opting for premium siding over standard stucco for a clean, sophisticated modern aesthetic. This siding and the tile roof—currently felted with tiles stacked—will be 100 percent complete prior to sale. The HVAC will be fully operational, and all electrical lighting completely installed before closing. Rough plumbing and valves are finished; quality fixtures are purchased and included but left uninstalled for your custom cabinetry choices. Permanent utilities will be fully connected and active prior to close. Property transfers prior to final occupancy with minimal finishes left to complete. Customize the interior with your choice of paint, flooring, countertops, appliances, and interior doors. results.remarks: Imagine waking each morning behind private gates, surrounded by mature trees, open skies, and breathtaking views of Temecula Wine Country. Set on more than 101,000 square feet of usable land, this exceptional equestrian zoned property is more than a home—it is a private retreat created for multigenerational living, entertaining, recreation, and endless possibilities. At the heart of the property is a spacious single-level  main residence offering approximately 2,950 square feet, four bedrooms, and three bathrooms. Comfortable and inviting, it provides plenty of room to gather with family, entertain friends, or simply enjoy the peaceful surroundings. A brand-new, approximately 650-square-foot ADU offers two bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a completely separate living space for extended family, guests, or rental possibilities. An additional barn shape structure has a huge living space above the garage ideal for guests, an office, studio, or private retreat. The property can also get a permit for 2nd ADU, creating even more future potential. Step outside and discover your own private resort. Spend warm afternoons beside the pool, entertain beneath the open sky, and enjoy your favorite beverage from the fully functioning four-tap beer station while taking in the panoramic wine-country views. Car enthusiasts, business owners, and hobbyists will appreciate the impressive workshop featuring a mechanical vehicle lift and washer and dryer hookups. Five RV hookup throughout the property provide flexibility for recreational vehicles, visitors, or equipment, while an EV charging station adds modern convenience. The land is both beautiful and productive, with more than 35 producing fruit trees, approximately 50 additional trees, raised garden beds, and automated irrigation. Three Wi-Fi-enabled irrigation control systems help maintain the grounds efficiently while reducing unnecessary water use. Three separate sets of fully paid Tesla solar panels provide exceptional energy efficiency. The current owners report having no electric bill—an incredible benefit for a property of this size. With room for horses, gardening, recreation, vehicles, guests, and future expansion, this estate offers a combination that is nearly impossible to replicate. There is no HOA telling you how to enjoy your land—just privacy, freedom, versatility, and the beauty of Temecula Wine Country. This is not simply a place to live. It is a place to gather, create, grow, celebrate, and build a legacy.

EXCEPTIONAL WINE COUNTRY RETREAT WITH GUEST HOUSE, RESORT-STYLE POOL, AND ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES
Commanding a premier hilltop setting in the heart of Temecula Wine Country, this stunning estate captures sweeping views in every direction and offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and versatility. Set on approximately five acres, the property welcomes you with a long, palm-lined drive leading to a residence designed to embrace its breathtaking surroundings.
The main home offers approximately 4,500 square feet of living space, thoughtfully laid out for both comfortable everyday living & entertaining. The spacious primary suite is a beautiful, featuring a private balcony overlooking the countryside and a luxurious bath complete with a steam shower. Three additional ensuite bedrooms provide exceptional accommodations, while a flexible bonus room can easily function as a home office, fitness room, playroom, or media space.
At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen opens seamlessly to the family room, creating an inviting gathering space for family & friends. Formal living and dining rooms add elegance, while an expansive library offers the potential for additional guest accommodations. Large windows throughout the home showcase the spectacular scenery from nearly every room.
Separate from the main residence, the pool house offers a private bedroom & bath along with an additional powder room, making it ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or rental opportunities.
Outdoor living is equally impressive. A resort-inspired pool with a dramatic waterfall grotto & waterslide creates a true backyard escape. Entertain with ease from the outdoor kitchen featuring a built-in BBQ, brick pizza oven, bar seating, and multiple patios designed for enjoying Temecula's beautiful weather year-round. Tucked among the grounds is a peaceful garden retreat where you can unwind while taking in sunsets and panoramic vistas.
The usable acreage provides outstanding flexibility for future expansion. A previously graded pad may accommodate an additional guest house, RV garage, workshop, or barn. With ample room for horses, vineyards, orchards, or recreational amenities, the possibilities are nearly limitless.
Whether you're searching for a private family compound, weekend retreat, equestrian property, or an investment opportunity in Wine Country, this exceptional estate offers a rare chance to enjoy one of Temecula's most sought-after lifestyles.

results.remarks:
Tucked within one of De Luz’s most coveted enclaves, where custom estates are quietly hidden among ancient oaks just minutes from Old Town Temecula, this remarkable estate was designed to create a place where life’s most meaningful moments simply unfold.

From intimate dinners beneath vine-covered terraces to hosting grand celebrations, every space has been designed for gathering, connection and effortless indoor-outdoor living.

Beyond the circular drive, nearly five acres of curated grounds unfold like a private park. Towering trees, seasonal blooms, tranquil pathways and expansive lawns surround a timeless residence of nearly 6,000 square feet, where soaring ceilings, custom millwork, rich hardwood flooring and walls of windows frame the surrounding landscape from nearly every room while filling the home with natural light throughout the day.

At the heart of the home, the chef’s kitchen is as functional as it is beautiful, featuring three oversized islands, professional-grade appliances, custom cabinetry, and seamless connection to the surrounding living spaces. The adjoining family room, anchored by a dramatic stone fireplace and exposed beams, opens effortlessly to the gardens beyond, creating a home that lives as beautifully outside as it does within.

Behind stately double doors, the executive library features custom built-ins, coffered ceilings, a fireplace, and tranquil garden views. The main-level primary suite is a peaceful retreat overlooking the grounds, complete with a spa-inspired bath, generous walk-in closet, and private access to the gardens. Dual staircases lead to an expansive upper level, where a spacious loft and three oversized bedrooms provide exceptional flexibility for multi-generational living, extended guests or growing families.

Outside, every path invites discovery. Dine beneath the vine-covered pergola, lounge beside the resort-style pool and spa with water features and ample space for entertaining, wander through flowering gardens beneath the shade of mature trees, or envision the future on the professionally graded pad with utilities already in place, ideal for a guest residence, equestrian amenities, workshop, or whatever your next chapter holds.

Rarely does a property combine this level of craftsmanship, warmth, privacy, and opportunity in one of De Luz’s most desirable locations. This is more than an extraordinary home. It is a legacy estate designed to be lived in, celebrated, and enjoyed for generations.

results.remarks: Passing by several of Temecula’s most esteemed wineries on Rancho CA Rd and then proceeding onto Calle Contento N you will arrive at this remarkable gated single-story residence with stunning views at the end of a cul-de-sac in the heart of Temecula Wine Country. As you walk through the front entry doors you are greeted by a captivating view of the pool and the rolling hills setting a tone of elegance that permeates the interior.The infinity-edge pool with a sun shelf and spa overlooks the rolling hills behind the property and a built-in fire pit provides warmth and a cozy ambiance under the star-filled sky making it an ideal spot for evening leisure.The family room features a custom built-in entertainment center and fireplace. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the family room to the kitchen providing a spacious and inviting area for family and friends to congregate.The built-in BBQ area boasts two large granite bars, high-top seating, and two mounted outdoor televisions under a covered Aluma wood awning that overlooks your working vineyard and an assortment of fruit trees, creating the perfect setting for outdoor gatherings and celebrations.For the ultimate movie-watching experience, the fully equipped high-end home theater is furnished with luxury staged theater seating ensuring that you can enjoy films in style and comfort.The master bedroom and spacious bath share a cozy fireplace and feature a large walk-in closet with custom cabinetry and a central island.Three of the four bedrooms are equipped with en-suite bathrooms, providing convenience and privacy for family members or guests. The fourth bedroom is currently utilized as an office with a double door entry.For car enthusiasts, the 6+ car garage offers ample space for your collection. One of the 2-car garages is equipped with a tall (RV-sized) entry door, perfect for installing a car lift or additional storage.This magnificent estate offers ample space for RVs, off-road vehicles, boats, trailers, and more. The property also features a lighted sports court suitable for basketball, pickleball/tennis. There is a flat turf area with plenty of room for outdoor games. A she shed offers an ideal solution for hosting guests or providing a private retreat. With its private entry and situated to overlook the sports court and vineyard it ensures visitors can enjoy the tranquility of wine country alongside the excitement of outdoor activities. Features a living room, bedroom, full bath and kitchenette.

results.remarks: The best location in De Luz, Temecula.. Perfectly situated in a gated community, just five minutes from the freeway, shopping, and dining, while overlooking the entire Temecula Valley. This stunning residence is truly one of a kind. Thoughtfully designed as a two story home that lives like a single story, the primary suite is ideally located on the main level, featuring a spacious bedroom and luxurious bathroom retreat. From the moment you enter through the formal entry, you are welcomed by elegant living spaces including a formal living room, formal dining room, and an inviting family room. At the heart of the home is a chef’s kitchen outfitted with premium Viking appliances, a generous layout, and an adjoining dining area perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The home offers 4 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, with three bedrooms featuring en suite full baths, and the fourth conveniently located near its own full bathroom. The lower level expands the home’s versatility with an additional family room/bonus room and a flexible space that can be used as an office, game room, or even a potential “casita” kitchen setup. Spanning approximately 4,381 square feet, the home features a beautiful open floor plan filled with natural light and mesmerizing views from nearly every window. Additional highlights include paid off solar and an oversized 3 car garage. Step outside to your private backyard oasis, complete with low maintenance astro turf, a putting green, and lush, mature landscaping with a variety of fruit trees. The highly upgraded outdoor covered patio is designed for year round enjoyment, featuring an outdoor kitchen, pitched wood ceiling, ambient lighting, and a jacuzzi perfectly positioned to take in the stunning city views. Upstairs, a covered patio offers yet another vantage point to soak in the panoramic scenery. The expansive lot provides ample space and opportunity to add a pool and spa, further enhancing this incredible property. Located within one of the only gated enclaves in De Luz with just four homes, this property offers a rare combination of exclusivity, seclusion, and accessibility. Built in 2010 and barely lived in, the home is in immaculate, truly move in ready condition. Just minutes from town and among the first homes in De Luz, this exceptional property delivers luxury living, privacy, and unforgettable views in one of Temecula’s most sought after locations. There is no HOA, low taxes, and no STR restrictions

results.remarks:
The standout feature of this Terracina home is the private two-bedroom Next Gen suite on the main level, complete with its own entrance, living room, kitchenette, full bathroom and dedicated laundry. It gives extended family or guests their own space while still keeping everyone under one roof.

Located in South Temecula, the home offers approximately 4,121 square feet with 7 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms. The main living area features an open-concept layout with a large center-island kitchen, walk-in pantry, abundant cabinetry and an easy flow into the dining and family rooms. Custom built-ins add additional storage and functionality.

Upstairs you'll find a spacious loft, junior suite with private bath, additional bedrooms, laundry room and a generous primary suite with dual vanities, soaking tub, separate shower and walk-in closet.

The backyard is another standout with a covered patio, built-in outdoor kitchen with BBQ, sink and refrigerator, spa and multiple seating areas. The lot offers added privacy with no direct rear neighbor and no immediate neighbor on one side.
